curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when Andrea offers Miranda a one-time modelling job and invites her and Mariano to the Seychelles?
curatedMovie.description: Mariano and Miranda's peaceful small-town marriage is upended when a slick photographer spots Miranda's striking looks and invites the hesitant couple to the Seychelles for a glamorous modeling shoot.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and breezy. An easy Italian date-night comedy set against a sun-drenched backdrop.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This Italian comedy follows a small-town couple after a photographer’s offer of a one-time modelling job takes them to the Seychelles.
